peering.definition: Looking carefully at something that is hard to see.

ancient.definition: Belonging to a time long ago.

boldly.definition: In a brave and confident way.

crest.definition: A raised part on top of an animal’s head.

fuzz.definition: A covering of very short soft hairs.

gasped.definition: Breathed in suddenly because of surprise.

panting.definition: Breathing quickly after running or feeling afraid.

shield.definition: A broad object that protects something.

medallion.definition: A large medal kept as a special object.

engraved.definition: Cut or carved into a hard surface.

crouching.definition: Bending low with the knees bent.

crouched.definition: Bent low with the knees bent.

bellowing.definition: Making a deep loud animal sound.

nest.definition: A place an animal makes for its eggs or young.

nests.definition: Places animals make for their eggs or young.

waddled.definition: Walked with short steps while swaying from side to side.

scrambled.definition: Moved or climbed quickly using hands and feet.

hunched.definition: Bent the back and shoulders forward.

stampede.definition: Rush together in a frightened group.

teetered.definition: Moved unsteadily as if about to fall.

grazing.definition: Eating grass or other low plants.

miracle.definition: An amazing event that seems almost impossible.

dizzy.definition: Feeling as if everything is turning around.

bolted.definition: Ran away or moved suddenly and quickly.

dazed.definition: Confused and unable to think clearly after a surprise.

shrugged.definition: Raised the shoulders to show uncertainty.

clasped.definition: Held something firmly in the hand.

tingle.definition: To feel a light prickling sensation.
